units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:8:3">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>מסרגין</he>, ib. I, 8) <he>ס׳ שתי וערב</he> strapping a bedstead means length- and breadthwise; (anoth. opin.) <he>ס׳ או שתי או ערב</he> strapping means either lengthwise &c. Bab.

M. Kat. 27ᵃ סֵירוּגוֹ מתוכו has the strapping inside (through slits in the frame); סֵירוּגָהּ על גבה the strapping over the frame.—Pl. סֵירוּגִים, סֵירוּגִין, סֵר׳ (adv., with or without prepos.) strapwise, in intervals, with interruption.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:2">Meg. II, 2</cite> <he>קראה ס׳</he> if one read the M’gillah in intervals (pausing between passages). Tosef.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4a">R. Hash. I</cite>V (II), 9 <he>אפי׳ בס׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>בסיריגין</he>, corr. acc.) even if one heard the notes of the Shofar at intervals extending even over the entire day.
Y. Meg. II, beg. 73ᵃ ס׳ קיטועין serugin means in sections.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:2:2">Ib.</cite> (Rabbi’s handmaid speaking Hebrew) <he>למה אתם נכנסין ס׳ ס׳</he> (not <cite ref="O00559"><he>סיגורין</he></cite>) why do you enter in a broken line?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:1:2">Y. Shebi. IX, beg. 38ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 18a:30">Meg. 18ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 26b:2">R. Hash. 26ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 60a:12">Gitt. 60ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 38a:1">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite> top <he>בס׳</he> (the oath for the suspected woman on the tablet) was written by sections, i.e. the headings of sections were written out, and the rest intimated by initial letters.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 62b:1">B. Bath. 62ᵇ</cite> top <he>בס׳ מהו</he> how is it, if he defined the borders of a field by the neighbors’ alternate names (omitting one name on every side where there were two neighbors)? <cite ref="Bava Kamma 37a:25">B. Kam. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>לס׳</he> for every alternate case of goring.

<cite ref="Niddah 68b:42">Nidd. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>מונה בס׳</he> he counts (the dags of cleanness) with interruptions; (Tosef. ib. IX, 13 <he>מסורגין</he>); a. e.—V. <cite ref="O00841"><he>סֵירוּס</he></cite>.
